main_body: two-story tavern/house with pitched orange-brown tile roof and plastered timber-frame front wall
top_band: orange-brown tiled roof slope with ridge highlight from row 0 to row 44
evidence: Rows 0-44 show the foreshortened pitched tile roof (45 rows tall) with a chimney showing its top opening at rows 8-10; row 44 marks the eave line, followed by a 1-2px eave shadow on the plaster wall at rows 45-46. The vertical front wall runs from row 45 to row 95 (51 rows) with recessed doorway, window sills, and an overhanging porch canopy at rows 61-65.

style.evidence: Rich multi-step roof tile shading (6+ warm brown/orange tones per tile with varied highlights), speckled plaster wall texture, grained timber beams, and detailed windows/doorway with dark material-toned outlines matching the Beodeul house references.
